answers.core: It will influence every Godot project using this feature.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around in theory. But - working on a "bigger" game (I am sure there are bigger and more complex games than mine, but it is a full game and has a ton of Nodes, Objects, effects. etc.) it is just so cumbersome to do it via Script.

Physics Interpolation is a fantastic feature, but also a feature that influences basically EVERY aspect of a project.
I think if there is a property that influences a lot of things, it should be easily accessible as a editor element.

title: Expose Physics Interpolation setting as a property in the editor
